events.body:
## Context

`public/js/notes.js:224` splits with `/[^.!?]+[.!?]+/g`, so `"Meeting notes. We agreed to encrypt everything before launch"` summarises to just `Meeting notes.`. The helper tests live in `tests/test_browser_js.py`, which CI excludes.

## What to do

1. Use `/[^.!?]+(?:[.!?]+|$)/g` and drop whitespace-only matches.
2. Expose `summarize` and friends on the object returned near `notes.js:409` and add a test CI runs (e.g. extend `tests/test_js_static.py` or call them via `node -e`).

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] The example keeps both sentences
- [ ] A CI-run test covers it
- [ ] Existing browser test still passes locally

## How to test locally

```bash
scripts/ci/test.sh blt-safecloak
```
